summary.name: NameQuick
summary.one_liner: NameQuick is an AI file renaming app for Mac and Windows that reads a file's contents and renames it by details like date, vendor and amount.
keywords: name files with date vendor amount
use_cases: Auto-naming files as they land in Downloads
Filing PDF invoices from email attachments
summary.what_it_does: NameQuick reads each file's text or image and writes a name based on what's inside, such as date, vendor, amount and document type. It can watch folders and rename new files as they arrive, or rename a batch on request, and a review mode holds each name for approval. It can also apply rules that sort or tag files after naming, pull PDF attachments from email, and find exact duplicate files. History keeps old names so changes can be undone. AI options are NameQuick's managed cloud, your own API key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or OpenRouter, or a local model through Ollama, LM Studio or MLX.
notable: Choice of AI: managed cloud, bring-your-own API key, or fully local model with no data leaving the computer
Watches folders and renames new files automatically, or holds names for review
Does not invent dates or amounts it cannot read; leaves those files for the user to fill in
Undo via History that keeps old and new names
caveats: Managed and rename packs are paid after free trial renames; Self-Managed is a one-time $69 license and needs your own key or a local model
Best name quality stated as Managed or own cloud key; local models are slower and smaller models write simpler names
MLX needs Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or later; Intel Macs are much slower; Finder tags and MLX are Mac-only
